```{r}
library(here)
```

## Myeloid subset

```{r}
so_M <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetMremovedoublets.rds"))
```

### Pseudobulk

```{r}
so_b2m_M <- subset(so_M %>% set_idents("genotype"), idents = "B2m KO")
so_b2m_M <- AddMetaData(
    so_b2m_M,
    metadata = so_b2m_M@meta.data %>%
        mutate(mouse_no_underscore = str_replace_all(mouse, "_", ".")) %>%
        select(mouse_no_underscore)
)
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so_b2m_M) %>% 
  plot_umap(color_str = "general_M_subtypes", label = T)

so_b2m_M <- AddMetaData(
    so_b2m_M,
    metadata = so_b2m_M@meta.data %>%
      mutate(general_M_subtypes_grouped = case_when(
        general_M_subtypes %in% c("MDSC", "Proliferating", "Macrophages", "Monocytes") ~ "Mac/mono", 
        TRUE ~ general_M_subtypes
      )) %>% 
      dplyr::select(general_M_subtypes_grouped)
)
```

```{r}
out <- run_or_readRDS(
  file.path(results_dir, "pb_b2m_Mgrouped.rds"),
  function() {
    pb_list <-
      make_pseudobulk(so_b2m_M, "general_M_subtypes_grouped", "mouse_no_underscore", "treatment")
    deseq_list <-
      map(pb_list,
          ~ pb_to_deseq(..1, sample_var = "general_M_subtypes_grouped", vars = "treatment"))
    rlog_list <-
      map(deseq_list, rlog, blind = TRUE)
    return(list(pb_list, deseq_list, rlog_list))
  }
)

pb_list <- out[[1]]
deseq_list <- out[[2]]
rlog_list <- out[[3]]
```

```{r}
norm_counts <- counts(deseq_list$`Mac/mono`, normalized = TRUE) %>%
      as_tibble(rownames = "gene")
saveRDS(norm_counts, file.path(results_dir, "pb_iso_macs_norm_counts.rds"))
```

```{r, eval = F}
results(deseq_list$`Mac/mono`) %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
  filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% 
  arrange(padj) %>% 
  filter(str_detect(gene, "Rpl|Rps", negate = TRUE)) %>% 
  datatable()
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
results(deseq_list$`Mac/mono`) %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
  filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% 
  arrange(padj) %>% 
  filter(str_detect(gene, "Rpl|Rps", negate = TRUE)) %>% 
  datatable()
```

```{r}
pb_dge_df <- results(deseq_list$`Mac/mono`) %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "gene") 
write_tsv(pb_dge_df, file.path(results_dir, "dge_pb_b2m_macs_cd40.v.iso.tsv"))
```

```{r}
pb_dge_df %>% 
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>% 
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>% 
  head(10)
```

#### Heatmap visualization of mac/mono only

```{r}
dge_cd40.v.iso <- pb_dge_df

topn <- 100
top_n_genes <- dge_cd40.v.iso %>% 
  filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% 
  arrange(padj) %>% 
  head(topn) %>% 
  .$gene
bot_n_genes <- dge_cd40.v.iso %>% 
  filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% 
  arrange(padj) %>% 
  head(topn) %>% 
  .$gene
```

```{r, fig.width = 3, fig.height = 5}
h_mtx <- norm_counts %>% 
  filter(gene %in% top_n_genes | gene %in% bot_n_genes) %>% 
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = c(top_n_genes, rev(bot_n_genes)))) %>% 
  arrange(gene) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  t() %>% 
  scale() %>% 
  t()
Heatmap(h_mtx, 
        cluster_rows = FALSE, 
        name = "scaled expr.",
        show_row_names = FALSE)
```

## all myeloid

### Pseudobulk

```{r}
so_b2m_M <- subset(so_M %>% set_idents("genotype"), idents = "B2m KO")
so_b2m_M <- AddMetaData(
    so_b2m_M,
    metadata = so_b2m_M@meta.data %>%
        mutate(mouse_no_underscore = str_replace_all(mouse, "_", ".")) %>%
        select(mouse_no_underscore)
)
```

```{r}
pb_M <- make_pseudobulk(so_b2m_M,
                       split_var = NULL,
                       sample_var = "mouse_no_underscore",
                       vars = "treatment")
deseq_M <- pb_to_deseq(pb_M, sample_var = "mouse_no_underscore", vars = "treatment")
rlog_M <- rlog(deseq_M, blind = TRUE)
norm_counts_M <- counts(deseq_M, normalized = TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "gene")
pb_M_dge_df <- results(deseq_M, name = "treatment_Isotype_vs_CD40.agonist") %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "gene") 
write_tsv(pb_M_dge_df, file.path(results_dir, "dge_pb_b2m_all-myeloid_cd40.v.iso.tsv"))
```


```{r}
bot_n_genes <- dge_cd40.v.iso %>%
```

```{r, fig.width = 3, fig.height = 5}
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = c(top_n_genes, rev(bot_n_genes)))) %>% 
  arrange(gene) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>%

"Cxcl16",
"Aif1",
"Ifi30",
"Ly6i",
"Ncf4",
"Iigp1",
"B2m",
"Acod1",

"Ccr9"

at <- which(rownames(h_mtx) %in% labels)
filtered_labels <- rownames(h_mtx)[rownames(h_mtx) %in% labels]
ha <- rowAnnotation(foo = anno_mark(at = at, labels = filtered_labels))

Heatmap(h_mtx, 
        right_annotation = ha,
        cluster_rows = FALSE, 
        name = "scaled expr.",
        show_row_names = FALSE)
```

## all monocyte

Brian specifies cluster 0, 1, 5, 7, 13, 14

### Pseudobulk

```{r}
monocyte_clusters <- c("0: MDSC", 
                       "1: Ccr2+ monocyte", 
                       "5: CD40-specific monocyte", 
                       "7: inflammatory monocyte", 
                       "13: Cx3cr1+ monocyte", 
                       "14: Ctsk+ monocyte")
Idents(so_b2m_M) <- "clusters_M"
so_b2m_monocyte <- subset(so_b2m_M, idents = monocyte_clusters)
```

```{r}
pb_M <- make_pseudobulk(so_b2m_monocyte,
                       split_var = NULL,
                       sample_var = "mouse_no_underscore",
                       vars = "treatment")
deseq_M <- pb_to_deseq(pb_M, sample_var = "mouse_no_underscore", vars = "treatment")
rlog_M <- rlog(deseq_M, blind = TRUE)
norm_counts_M <- counts(deseq_M, normalized = TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "gene")
write_tsv(norm_counts_M, file.path(results_dir, "pb-b2m-only_all-monocytes_normalized_counts.tsv"))
pb_M_dge_df <- results(deseq_M, name = "treatment_Isotype_vs_CD40.agonist") %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "gene") 
write_tsv(pb_M_dge_df, file.path(results_dir, "dge_pb_b2m_all-monocyte_cd40.v.iso.tsv"))
```

## All

```{r}
so <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10.rds"))
```

### Pseudobulk

```{r}
so_b2m <- subset(so %>% set_idents("genotype"), idents = "B2m KO")
so_b2m <- AddMetaData(
  so_b2m,
  metadata = so_b2m@meta.data %>%
    mutate(mouse_no_underscore = str_replace_all(mouse, "_", ".")) %>%
    select(mouse_no_underscore)
)
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so_b2m) %>% 
  plot_umap(color_str = "general_cell_types", label = T)

so_b2m <- AddMetaData(
  so_b2m,
  metadata = so_b2m@meta.data %>%
    mutate(is_immune = ifelse(general_cell_types %in% c("B", "Myeloid", "T/NK"), 
                              "immune", 
                              "not immune")) %>%
    select(is_immune)
)
```

```{r}
out <- run_or_readRDS(
  file.path(results_dir, "pb_b2m_all.rds"),
  function() {
    pb_list <-
      make_pseudobulk(so_b2m, "is_immune", "mouse_no_underscore", "treatment")
    deseq_list <-
      map(pb_list,
          ~ pb_to_deseq(..1, sample_var = "is_immune", vars = "treatment"))
    rlog_list <-
      map(deseq_list, rlog, blind = TRUE)
    return(list(pb_list, deseq_list, rlog_list))
  }
)

pb_list <- out[[1]]
deseq_list <- out[[2]]
rlog_list <- out[[3]]
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
results(deseq_list$immune) %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
  filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% 
  arrange(padj) %>% 
  filter(str_detect(gene, "Rpl|Rps", negate = TRUE)) %>% 
  datatable()
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
results(deseq_list$immune) %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
  filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% 
  arrange(padj) %>% 
  filter(str_detect(gene, "Rpl|Rps", negate = TRUE)) %>% 
  datatable()
```

```{r}
pb_dge_df <- results(deseq_list$immune) %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "gene") 
write_tsv(pb_dge_df, file.path(results_dir, "dge_pb_b2m_all_cd40.v.iso.tsv"))
```

```{r}
pb_dge_df %>% 
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>% 
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>% 
  head(10)
```
